rows.scenario: Second process launch rejected while candidate runs
rows.evidence: Windows w0-2: second launch → 'organism lease held: the shared Vivy workspace is already in use by another process' (code -32086), second process exits, primary unaffected. Note: lease fires inside Compose before Wails exists, so OnSecondInstanceLaunch→reopen() is unreachable (finding F2). Linux leg identical

rows.scenario: SIGKILL then relaunch on the same profile reopens the runtime and journal
rows.evidence: Windows w0-2: taskkill /F → immediate relaunch correctly rejected (lease row survives; TTL 30s heartbeat 10s — crash-safety margin) → relaunch after TTL expiry → 'vivy host opened' on same .vivy/vivy.db, window renders. Linux leg: kill -9 → relaunch opened (TTL nuance not recorded there)

rows.scenario: Normal quit path releases workspace and exits
rows.evidence: Windows w0-2: CTRL_BREAK (Wails SIGINT/SIGTERM handler → a.Quit()) → 'Quitting application...' → 'speech teardown: inflight=0 joined=0' → 'teardown complete' → exit; lease released — immediate relaunch opens with no TTL wait. No UI quit affordance exists (finding F3): no tray menu/quit control; signal path is the only graceful quit

rows.scenario: Hide/reopen keeps the same runtime, no replayed audio
rows.evidence: Windows w0-2 live drive: hide works (window X and taskkill WM_CLOSE both hide; process + runtime stay alive; tray icon 'DIVA desktop' present; hide hook invalidates speech context). REOPEN FAILS: tray created without AttachWindow/SetMenu → click inert, no menu; d.reopen() only reachable via OnSecondInstanceLaunch which can never fire — Compose() opens the sealed host first and the organism lease kills instance 2 before the Wails app exists. Once hidden the window cannot be reopened except by killing the process. Fix: tray.AttachWindow(w) + reopen on second-instance before host open
